turns.teacher: Good morning children! Very nice, everyone is sitting so nicely today. Today we will do subtraction. Our first sum is fifty two minus twenty seven.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Rabi, you said thirty five? No, no, that is wrong. Arjoon, you tell.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: Thirty five again? Listen. The answer is twenty five. Fifty two minus twenty seven is twenty five. Everybody say it with me, twenty five.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Very good, very good, lovely voices! Thumbs up if you understood. Show me thumbs.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Okay, next sum. Sixty one minus thirty four. Try it in your notebook.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Mina, you counted on fingers and got twenty eight? Wrong, beta. Don't use fingers, it is a bad habit. Just write it properly.
turns.label: move_on_or_scold

turns.teacher: See, I am telling again. When the top number is small, you borrow. You borrow. You BORROW one ten. Then you subtract. Borrow, then subtract. Okay?
turns.label: repeat_same_way

turns.teacher: Sixty one minus thirty four is twenty seven. Write twenty seven. Arjun, cross out your answer and write twenty seven.
turns.label: tell_answer

turns.teacher: Super, Sana has written it neatly! Now one more. Seventy three minus forty six. Quickly, quickly.
turns.label: new_sum

turns.teacher: Ravi, again you did small from big? I told you so many times, borrow! Borrow one ten, then subtract. Borrow first, then take away. Listen carefully this time.
turns.label: repeat_same_way
